raw_response:
This plot is small and I am only renting it, so I do not want to put too much money into it. I plan to grow groundnuts with some pigeon pea mixed in, because legumes do not need much fertilizer and they help the soil for whoever uses it next. Any fertilizer coupon I get from FISP I will save for my maize plot, not this one. I will use seed I kept from last season and work it with my own hands — on such a small piece of land I do not need to hire anyone.
